source_datasets.name: KNBS 2019 KPHC Volume IV, table 2.30: distribution of population by religious affiliation and county

licence.name: KNBS census reports, open download; no explicit reuse licence stated

source_datasets.citation: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics, 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, Volume IV, Table 2.30.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: The census PDF is not committed; the derived public product attributes KNBS and links the source.
source_datasets.notes: Table 2.30 gives 47 counties plus the KENYA national row across 13 religion categories; parsed with pdftotext -layout. The stated-response denominator excludes Don't Know and Not Stated.

source_datasets.notes: 47 ADM1 counties; shapeISO carries the ISO 3166-2 KE-NN codes used as area codes.

indicators.label: Stated religion-response denominator
indicators.description: County total minus the Don't Know and Not Stated categories in table 2.30.
indicators.method: table 2.30 total minus Don't Know minus Not Stated.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Kenya counties (geoBoundaries ADM1) in the 2019 census.
indicators.quality_notes: Percentages use a stated religion-response denominator: the table 2.30 county total minus Don't Know and Not Stated. Those two residual categories are excluded from the denominator, not counted as no religion.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator declaring any named religion.
indicators.method: 100 * (Catholic + Protestant + Evangelical Churches + African Instituted Churches + Orthodox + Other Christian + Islam + Hindu + Traditionists + Other Religion) / (total - Don't Know - Not Stated).
indicators.spatial_coverage: Kenya counties (geoBoundaries ADM1) in the 2019 census.
indicators.quality_notes: Percentages use a stated religion-response denominator: the table 2.30 county total minus Don't Know and Not Stated. Those two residual categories are excluded from the denominator, not counted as no religion.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator in the No religion/Atheists category.
indicators.method: 100 * No religion/Atheists / (total - Don't Know - Not Stated).
indicators.spatial_coverage: Kenya counties (geoBoundaries ADM1) in the 2019 census.
indicators.quality_notes: Percentages use a stated religion-response denominator: the table 2.30 county total minus Don't Know and Not Stated. Those two residual categories are excluded from the denominator, not counted as no religion.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.notes: All ten named-religion categories count as religious affiliation.

visual_layers.label: No religion %
visual_layers.notes: No religion is the No religion/Atheists category; Don't Know and Not Stated are excluded from the denominator.
